completion_data.completion_summary: Added two prose provisions to the core extension's source-store plan-format.md: a decision gate already [BLOCKED] at plan-authoring time is now reconciled against the final-phase transitive-dependency rule (wave-1 placement, Depends on: none, final-phase re-observation MUST), and the plan-level Status field's ownership (update-plan-status.sh only, never a phase checklist item) with its sanctioned [BLOCKED]/[COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS] alternative is now documented at the exact location context/contracts/plan-status-ownership.md already points at. Deployed via deploy-headless.sh (RESULT=landed_verify_clean) and verified against the full gate set with no new finding attributable to this record.

memory_candidates.content: When invoking agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/verify-deploy.sh with an explicit TARGET_REPO argument to check a source-store-only gate (e.g. --only-gate 3,4 doc-lint/task-reference lint) from outside the nvim config repo, TARGET must be the nvim config repo root (e.g. /home/benjamin/.config/nvim, which contains both agent-system/extensions/ and .claude/) -- never an individual extension's own source-store subdirectory (agent-system/extensions/<ext>), which lacks a .claude/ tree and errors exit 2 'no deploy tree'. Also run the deployed generate-context-line-counts.sh --write from that same repo root first if a context/formats/*.md file just grew, to clear a transient gate-3 line-count mismatch before it's cleared automatically by the next deploy-headless.sh run.
